learned_selector: a[href] filtered to observed article routes /articles/ or /article/ with a document-like slug; card/title links in the sample include h3 and .colBoxIcon parents.
operation_rule: Collect links while the listing is open, then save up to max_items. Scroll at most six times when needed; save navigates to each detail page.
assumptions_and_limits: Article path filtering follows the supplied ITmedia listing and representative article only; other editorial route forms may be missed.
